verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy documents its own API for building and testing a full integration in Test mode, and webhooks can be set up programmatically, so the platform can be driven without its UI. There is no evidence of a CLI, CI-specific guidance, or headless auth flows, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: official CLI or CI tooling, documented non-interactive auth/token setup for pipelines, OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can build and test a full API integration with Lemon Squeezy using [Test mode]
Using the API, you can set up webhooks and subscribe to events programatically.
